results.title: Tomorrow I'll Be Brave
results.overview: If twelve-year-old Karl had been able to choose who he fell in love with, it would not have been the much taller Lea from his class. Now he doesn't have much time to fnd out whether Lea can reciprocate his feelings. After the summer holidays, she will change schools​.

results.title: Concrete Sky
results.overview: The daily journey the balloon girl takes, witnessing the effects of the apartheid wall, as it separates children from their schools, families from each other and people from their land.

results.title: MUSA
results.overview: A muse poses in the void before an indistinguishable photographer.

results.title: CLICKBAIT
results.overview: An ensemble of influencers collide when a hard drive falls into the wrong hands.

results.title: Teach Me
results.overview: A middle-Class parent struggles to admit their son to school. The-Five Year- Old who doesn't speak at the interview and oral tests held at grade one enrollment is denied admission. The exhausting process takes a toll on the parents marriage and leads to a temporary separation. The boys father who works for the Forest Department decides not to send his child to school anymore. Instead, he takes the boy to his work site and educates his son himself. Determined to change a system that denies all children a level playing field, he hatches a plan that he thinks will get the attention of the Minister of Education.

results.title: Air War
results.overview: Over a dozen current and former pilots take us into the cockpits of legendary fighter planes and into the heart of legendary battles. They come from various nations, and their service ranges from the air battles of the First World War to the front lines in Ukraine. Some are well-known names. Others have had to keep their activities—and even their identities—secret. Some have broken down barriers and forged new paths. All have exciting stories to tell.

results.title: Wine & Secrets
results.overview: An engaged couple's lives turn upside down after deciding to tell each other their deepest, darkest secrets.

results.original_title: How to Be Normal and the Oddness of the Other World
results.overview: Fresh out of a psychiatric hospital, Pia moves back in with her parents to get her life together. Torn between a new job, lovesickness, psychotropic drugs and social stigmatization, she emerges into a world where everything seems out of control.

results.title: The KoolPals Comedy Special

results.overview: On her wedding day, Catalina flees throught the streets of a small village in search of answers, freedom, and a bus stop.

results.title: El silenci de la llar
results.overview: Sara, a responsible and outgoing girl, accidentally breaks her boyfriend Carlos' cell phone. Sara tries to calm him down, but Carlos' aggressive personality makes it very difficult for her.

results.title: Baldız

results.title: Bagworm
results.overview: After a sexually frustrated hammer salesman steps on a rusty nail, he must determine whether the world’s sudden and violent turn against him is real or the result of an infection consuming his body and mind.

results.title: Arizona
results.overview: A contemplative and poetic short film depicting the otherworldly landscapes of North American deserts.

results.title: My Partners
results.overview: Three Estonian and German couples explore polyamory, confronting ego, desire, and insecurity while redefining love. Guided by mentors, psychologists, shamans, and dancers, they navigate years of sexual freedom and emotional struggle under filmmaker Eva Kübar’s patient lens. After a decade together, Riita and Taavi open their relationship and join a camp where unconventional practices test their limits. Marianne and Sven attempt to save their marriage for their children, though Marianne’s bond with her lover Kay complicates her promise to stay faithful. For Kay’s wife Beate, Marianne’s presence becomes both a threat and an opportunity for growth.

results.title: Mummy!
results.overview: Yelling ‘Mummy’ isn’t just a reflex. It’s love written in our instincts.

results.title: Nemesis
results.overview: During a Phoenix Grand Prix, Wu Luo, an oriental beast that had disappeared for 20 years, reappeared, bringing great disaster and panic to the city. Wu Luo was injured in the attack and hid in a cave to recuperate. Zhang Xiaozao, a young racing genius, was overconfident and led a team of four to risk a sneak attack on the injured Wu Luo, which instead triggered a more serious crisis. Faced with the blow, Zhang Xiaozao, with the help and encouragement of weapons expert Lai Daozhang, not only improved his combat effectiveness, but also regained his lost confidence. At the critical moment when Wu Luo was about to destroy Phoenix City, Zhang Xiaozao stepped forward, turned the tide, successfully saved the entire city, and eventually became a new generation of city hero.
